result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, I'd recommend **Xero, QuickBooks or FreeAgent**\. The best choice depends on how your business operates, whether you're VAT registered, and whether you employ staff.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best accounting software compared

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall)

**1\. Xero**

Great for small businesses that want to grow. Excellent bank reconciliation, invoicing, reporting and integrations.

Best for: Limited companies and growing businesses.

From approximately £7/month + VAT.

[Visit Xero](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks**

Very good all-round accounting package. Handles expenses, invoices, VAT, bank feeds and financial reports.

Best for: Small businesses wanting comprehensive bookkeeping.

From approximately £16/month + VAT.

[Visit QuickBooks](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![FreeAgent Review: Features, Pricing, Pros & Cons](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/AWrYG5UElICV_2QqNniGBOJg-DuJb7bzMDkMbcm700h1nQnWQTJ-0M80r1lnMU0oD2rFCgi2YvXIZB2Umi8wczyWPQfft3pogJ8F48-Lsaw-bXn26n8ROlYeIROX9k57q9T8hKC5ow8yJaZsxkoZIQjbRlS28cXXnAUhnN7Xx_NmwItPbM1G2HrfhOQcoZLf?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. FreeAgent**

Straightforward accounting, tax estimates, invoicing and expense tracking. Can be free with certain qualifying UK business bank accounts.

Best for: Sole traders, freelancers and smaller businesses.

Free with qualifying bank accounts.

[Visit FreeAgent](https://www.freeagent.com/)

---

![Sage Group | Company Overview & News](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/VFRaM7Mi6n-B6kypx5NEbH6uZ7gv6tyckO56Q4NaZ2LIxfSUsJX7-BpQgCEEs8eZ1yCTkoB51T4Vi6uho9n0Uh-lEm2VXgC1WYeJjEoJCLFmEjEBjRNPbTFFtsAcn4mH6vl8NHzKL61NACimMLcmOKip1T__uRJNPku-4fp2J-5qEQ-yptJXrboOZoUqd8Yu?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Sage Accounting**

Strong UK accounting functionality, VAT reporting and options for businesses with payroll requirements.

Best for: Established small businesses.

[Visit Sage](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

!["Best 10 Zoho Apps for Small Businesses in 2024 - Must-Have Tools" | C3 Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/QMBJut4kUVy6UNtA0DcEcpSKElNdEgHfabBOoR3AWTMUo6phHjAJ01KBTRk_iU44CUuVy6AD0OeM48UFtluYC3mtudqFVjYFesk47WQPcQQfsgxz1-Ctp0z-lODm5vgYFvDQ7IEjwcEwqAsNX1booH4Twqog2tqxnwaLYmRuRR9TviU8hG6khxNJKfVoO6Q2?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Books**

Good value, automation, invoicing and expense management.

Best for: Start-ups and budget-conscious businesses.

Free plan available for qualifying users.

[Visit Zoho Books](https://www.zoho.com/uk/books/)

## Which would I choose?

| Business type | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Sole trader | FreeAgent |
| Small limited company | Xero |
| VAT-registered business | Xero or QuickBooks |
| Business with employees | Sage or Xero |
| Freelancer | FreeAgent |
| Growing business | Xero |
